_comment: Exported server actions that call no revalidatePath/revalidateTag/updateTag/refresh/redirect, each READ AND
CLASSIFIED by a caller-trace (.handoff/check-action-freshness/01-census.md, tree 7cf6feb3) — never EXEMPT.
Keyed per action, so a new action in a listed file is not covered. This file only shrinks: an action that
starts refreshing, or is deleted, fails the check until its entry leaves. Classes: read · indirect (a callee
elsewhere refreshes) · client-refresh (every caller refreshes or rebuilds the view itself) · no-view (writes nothing a
view reads back) · internal (no client calls it; its route or action caller owns freshness) · uncalled.
The 14 the census and its walker found stale or resting on local state were fixed, not listed.
